title: Garlic Wholesome Russian Chicken
description: A hearty and flavorful dish combining the richness of Russian cuisine with the wholesomeness of fresh ingredients, all tied together with a garlicky twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chicken, wholesome flour, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer chicken to a baking dish and set aside.
Add onion, carrots, and potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, or until tender.
Add tagine to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the onion and vegetable mixture over the chicken in the baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
